P3.inputs: The byte-identical three original milai_odr_v19 fixtures and mechanism freezes. No new wording, tool schemas, expected-value hints or authority changes.
P3.reference: A3 at 024fa69 is the sealed prior comparison. New CLI also supports matched A3 on the same source; do not automatically rerun a reference when no causal question requires it.
P3.initial_exposure: X@1 must really be returned by ordinary search and delivered to a Provider request before fixture external update.
P3.changed: Current exact X@2 must be delivered, superseded factual body withheld, original ordinary assistant output generated under X@1 demoted, and one approved business action records Lumen-42 at 8 C at public index 2.
P3.retained: Current exact X@2 must be delivered and original stale-snapshot output demoted before the one approved action records 8; value equality alone is insufficient.
P3.irrelevant: Current primary X remains intact and action is 8, with no induced primary lookup or Host search after update. Report Y exact reads and demotions caused by its snapshot presence independently; mechanical snapshot risk is not semantic causal attribution.
P3.history: Original checkpoint ToolMessages and assistant texts remain unchanged; tool-call JSON, role and position remain in the Provider history. Bind ordinary text by actual AIMessage/response identity plus hash, not text-value matching.
P3.lineage: Recover generating request and exact namespace/id/revision from actual delivered material. A3 refreshed X@2 must not be mislabeled as original search X@1; withheld or UNKNOWN bodies cannot become exact support.
P3.business: No mechanical truth gate or argument rewrite; record actual actions and all Host memory writes. Expected values are evaluation-only.

P4.gate: Expand after P3 is understood; at least one non-temperature pass is required for v20, while all declared generic controls remain in the master scope. Do not enter formal benchmark if categorical/boolean fails.
P4.assistant_only: A harness-only request-copy filter omits search ToolMessages from public index 0 after that index, preserving checkpoint and actual lineage. Newly acquired search results remain visible. Identical view policy for matched arms; no case-name branch in SER.
P4.missing_exposure: If initial retrieval/rank conditions are absent, report invalid mechanism exposure separately from semantic outcome, not an automatic pass. Any input correction receives a new version preserving old evidence.

metrics.rebase_precision: Actually demoted ordinary outputs with a verified stale/deleted generating snapshot / all demoted outputs. This is mechanical provenance precision, not word-level causal precision.
metrics.rebase_recall: Demoted eligible ordinary outputs / eligible stale-snapshot ordinary outputs in the pre-projection request. Do not use the post-demotion remainder as a denominator; report UNKNOWN bindings separately.
metrics.refresh_precision: Report exact reads contributing primary current action evidence / all exact reads, alongside timing relative to action. Reads of irrelevant Y and post-action followup refreshes are separately visible; 0/0 is undefined.
metrics.stale_consumption: Report actual stale-value actions and the exposed action opportunities; do not infer semantic use from value coincidence in retained.
metrics.preservation: Compare unaffected current items/order, tool history, no-stale behavior and approved action, and separately count unnecessary demotion/refresh.
metrics.cost: All generations/input/output/embedding/exact reads/projection CPU and wall/storage, including failures and rejected or truncated responses. Ordinary ReAct followups are not independent State calls.

stage_stop: Complete the small frozen group unless a transport/implementation failure makes execution invalid. Preserve every failed attempt, diagnose one first broken link with at least two hypotheses, choose a minimal general fix and counterexample, and freeze a new run. Do not stop the master Goal merely because A4 fails, nor enlarge benchmarks before gates.
